in_marathi.name: Kalyan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Fortune, prosperity, happiness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kalyan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Kalyan means 'fortune', 'prosperity', 'happiness'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kalyana', which also means 'auspicious'. In Hindu mythology, Kalyan is a term used to describe a wedding ceremony, symbolizing the beginning of a new life filled with joy, prosperity, and love.
